name: Pavlov VR
description: The VR shooter (CS-style Search and Destroy, TDM, gun game). Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).

install.content:
[/Script/Pavlov.DedicatedServer]
bEnabled=true
ServerName="{{HOSTNAME}}"
MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}
bSecured=true
MapRotation=(MapId="datacenter", GameMode="SND")
MapRotation=(MapId="sand", GameMode="SND")

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: Pavlov also uses game port + 400 for pings (default 8177). Open both.

variables.label: Ping port (UDP)
variables.description: Always game port + 400. Keep this in sync with the game port.

notes: Pavlov's server needs GLIBC 2.27+ and a steamclient.so reachable by the launcher script — if startup fails with a missing steamclient.so, symlink it from the panel's SteamCMD linux64 directory into ~/.steam/sdk64/. Map rotation, gamemodes and passwords live in Pavlov/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini; Pavlov's RCON (RconSettings.txt) is a custom telnet-style protocol, not Source RCON.
